Position description: #*PROGRAM MANAGER CUM FACULTY COORDINATOR – PUNJAB EXAMS*#

#*Role Objective*#

The Program Manager cum Faculty Coordinator will be responsible for managing the end-to-end academic and operational execution of the Punjab Exams category while simultaneously owning faculty acquisition, onboarding, scheduling, performance management, and coordination. This is a dual-responsibility role that bridges program strategy with faculty operations, ensuring seamless delivery of high-quality academic programs to students.

A. Program Management Responsibilities

• Own the overall execution, planning, and growth of the Punjab Exams category.

• Plan and launch academic programs, batches, courses, test series, and exam-oriented initiatives aligned with the Punjab exam calendar.

• Define program structure, batch timelines, subject-wise schedules, and content delivery roadmap.

• Monitor batch performance, student engagement, completion rates, and learning outcomes.

• Coordinate with marketing, content, social media, YouTube, product, and sales teams to drive student acquisition and retention.

• Develop and execute strategies to improve student enrolment, engagement, satisfaction, and course completion.

• Track business and academic KPIs and prepare regular performance dashboards for leadership.

• Analyse market trends, competitor activities, and student requirements to identify new growth opportunities.

• Ensure timely execution of launches, campaigns, classes, content drops, and academic initiatives.

• Take ownership of cross-functional execution and ensure timely delivery of all key milestones.

B. Faculty Coordination Responsibilities

• Identify, source, evaluate, and onboard faculty members across all subjects for the Punjab Exams category.

• Plan and manage faculty schedules, class timetables, and session allocations across batches.

• Act as the single point of contact between faculty members and internal teams (content, video, product, marketing).

• Monitor faculty performance through student feedback, class ratings, attendance data, and content quality reviews.

• Conduct regular faculty reviews, feedback sessions, and development discussions.

• Ensure faculty readiness for live classes, recorded sessions, doubt-solving slots, and special sessions.

• Manage faculty communication, escalations, and day-to-day operational requirements.

• Coordinate content creation activities with faculty — including notes, quizzes, PYQs, study material, and video lectures.

• Ensure faculty alignment with the latest exam patterns, syllabus updates, and academic standards.

• Build and maintain a healthy faculty pipeline and backup pool for business continuity.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline

• 3–7 years of experience in Program Management, Academic Operations, Faculty Management, or Category Management.

• Prior experience in EdTech, coaching institutes, or the competitive exam preparation industry is strongly preferred.

• Proven track record of managing academic programs and coordinating with teaching faculty.

• Strong project management, planning, and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and execution capabilities.

• Outstanding communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and manage multiple priorities.

• Understanding of Punjab Government Exams, their syllabus, and the competitive exam ecosystem will be an added advantage.

• Proficiency in tools such as Google Workspace, MS Office, project management platforms, and data dashboards.

Associate Manager – Student Success & Mentor Operations (VP-RP)

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated and execution-oriented professional to lead Results & Mentor Operations across all VP-RP centers. The role is responsible for driving academic performance,student attendance & overall student success by ensuring effective execution of mentor-led initiatives.

The individual will work closely with principals, center heads, academic teams, and mentors to analyze branch performance, identify improvement opportunities, formulate result-oriented strategies, and ensure their effective implementation across all centers. The role demands a strong analytical mindset, operational excellence, and the ability to convert data into actionable plans that improve student outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Mentor Operations Management

Drive execution of all mentor responsibilities across VP-RP centers, including attendance management, parent connect, mentor check-ins, supervised study hours, student counseling, and academic tracking.

Monitor mentor productivity and ensure adherence to defined SOPs.

Conduct regular review meetings with mentors and principals to improve execution quality.

2. Academic Result Tracking & Performance Analysis

Monitor and analyze branch-wise academic performance across weekly tests, milestones, AITS, and other assessments.

Prepare comprehensive performance reports highlighting strengths, gaps, trends, and risk areas across centers.

Track the academic progress of individual students, batches, and branches to identify performance patterns and intervention opportunities.

Evaluate the effectiveness of previous interventions and recommend improvements based on data.

3. Strategy Planning & Result Driving

Design and implement structured strategies to improve student academic performance across all branches.

Based on performance analysis, prepare branch-specific action plans before every major assessment.

Develop mentor execution plans for:

Weak student improvement

High-potential student acceleration

Attendance improvement

Revision planning

Homework and DPP compliance

Error Notebook implementation

Study Hour optimization

Parent engagement

Test readiness

Ensure every branch executes these strategies consistently and review their impact after each assessment.

Continuously refine strategies based on branch performance, student outcomes, and mentor feedback.

4. Attendance & Student Engagement

Monitor attendance trends and identify students at risk of absenteeism.

Drive attendance improvement initiatives through mentor-led interventions.

Ensure disciplined execution of hostel routines and supervised study hours.

5. Parent Engagement

Drive structured Parent Connect initiatives across all VP-RP centres.

Ensure parents receive timely updates regarding attendance, academic progress, discipline, and student well-being.

Develop parent engagement strategies to improve student accountability and consistency.

6. Mentor Capability Development

Train mentors on student counseling, academic monitoring, motivational techniques, and result-oriented mentoring practices.

Share best practices and standardize mentor interventions across all centers.

Conduct periodic mentor performance reviews and identify capability-building opportunities.

7. Cross-functional Coordination

Collaborate with academic teams, center heads, hostel operations, and central academic teams to ensure seamless implementation of academic and mentor-led initiatives.

Drive timely closure of action items arising from academic reviews and performance discussions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Improvement in Branch-wise Academic Results

  • Student Attendance Improvement

  • Weekly Test, SPT, Milestone & AITS Score Improvement

  • Number of Students Moving to Higher Score Bands

  • Timely Preparation and Execution of Branch-wise Action Plans

  • Mentor Task Completion & Compliance

  • Parent Connect Compliance

  • Student Retention & Reduced Scheme Changes

  • Effectiveness of Mentor-led Academic Interventions

jobDescription:
Job Title: Associate – Student Welfare Services

Location: Chandigarh
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview:

The Associate – Student Welfare Services will play a pivotal role in fostering a supportive, inclusive, and engaging environment for students. This individual will be responsible for implementing welfare initiatives, managing student grievances, supporting mental health and well-being programs, and facilitating access to essential student resources and services. The role demands empathy, strong interpersonal skills, and a proactive attitude toward enhancing the overall student experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Student Support Services:

    • Serve as the first point of contact for student welfare inquiries.

    • Facilitate access to mental health and counseling resources.

    • Provide guidance on academic and non-academic support systems.

  • Welfare Program Implementation:

    • Assist in designing and executing programs aimed at enhancing student well-being, including orientation, wellness workshops, awareness campaigns, and peer support initiatives.

    • Coordinate with internal departments and external agencies to deliver these programs effectively.

  • Grievance Management:

    • Receive, document, and escalate student complaints and concerns to relevant departments.

    • Track resolution progress and ensure timely and appropriate responses.

  • Communication & Outreach:

    • Develop and disseminate student welfare materials such as newsletters, policy briefs, and event promotions.

    • Manage communication channels including email, social media, and welfare portals.

  • Event Planning and Coordination:

    • Organize student welfare events, awareness days, and training sessions.

    • Collaborate with student bodies and clubs for inclusive engagement.

  • Data Management & Reporting:

    • Maintain records of student cases, participation in welfare activities, and feedback.

    • Assist in preparing periodic reports and presentations on welfare metrics and outcomes.

Key Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Social Work, Education, or related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.

  • Experience: 1-3 years of relevant experience in student affairs, counseling, or administrative support in an educational environment.

  • Skills:

    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

    • High emotional intelligence and cultural sensitivity.

    • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.

    • Organizational and problem-solving capabilities.

    • Proficiency in MS Office; experience with student information systems is a plus.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Experience working with young adults in educational settings.

  • Awareness of mental health issues and student welfare trends.

  • Ability to handle multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Passionate about student development and engagement.
